change.source: finding 4 (a key file whose key id holds a line break, which inbox key new makes without complaint, fails every client command with exit 2 and a line that names no key file): not changed in this story. The key file is the caller's own; that inbox key new accepts such a key id was so before this story, and a check where the file is read would take away the only part of a request head the case of finding 3 can reach. Filed as the draft story:a-key-id-with-a-control-character-is-refused-where-it-is-made, which waits until the planned waves are delivered
